title: iria sphaerocephala
intro: Iria sphaerocephala, commonly known as Globe Head, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Iria sphaerocephala include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
